desc: Normalize conflicting pairs: for each pair [a,b], set L=min(a,b), R=max(a,b).
Implement the optimized O(m log m + n) solution using a sweep-line with a min-heap.
Group pairs by R and sort them.
Sweep j from 1 to n, maintaining a min-heap of L values for pairs with R <= j.
Compute F[j] = min L for pairs with R <= j.
Compute total_invalid for the full set.
For each pair k=(Lk, Rk), calculate the reduction in invalid subarrays if it is removed. This requires knowing how many j >= Rk have F[j] == Lk AND pair k is the unique provider of that minimum.
To do this efficiently: maintain a count of each L in the heap. If the min L is unique, the impact of removing that specific pair is (min_L - second_min_L) for all j where it is the unique minimizer.
The best removal is the one that maximizes this total loss (minimizes remaining invalid).
Handle edge cases: no pairs, pairs with same L/R, etc.
Write the final Python code within the class structure.
